title: View Kind nemar.heatmap, Version 1
description: Generic heatmap, applied on top of the envelope to a view declaration whose kind is nemar.heatmap and kind_version 1. One stored TSV file is read as the role values: a matrix of numeric cells, drawn one flat cell per stored value with no interpolation. One dimension runs along the rows: its labels are a column of the file, or, for a preset over this kind, a column of another of the preset's roles. The other runs along the columns: each declared column other than the row-label column is one column of the matrix, and its label is the column name or comes from another role. A renderer builds the model in docs/views/generic-kinds.md. This is a generic kind, so it has no base, no inputs and no transform.

base.description: A generic kind has no base.

base_version.description: A generic kind has no base.

inputs.description: A heatmap is stored data only.

transform.description: A heatmap is stored data only.

limits.description: minmax spans the smallest to the largest cell with a sequential map; absmax spans minus to plus the largest absolute cell with a diverging map centered on zero.

data.description: Exactly one file, read as the role values.

items.description: The role values: an optional row-label column and one numeric column per matrix column. A preset drawn over this kind meets this subschema with its own values entry (docs/views.md, the role contract).

columns.description: The row-label column, when the row labels are in this file, and the matrix columns, in declared order. Matrix columns are numeric; the model refuses a text one (value_type).

dims.description: Exactly two dimensions with open names: the row dimension, with its labels in a column of this file or of another role, and the column dimension, with its labels in the header or in another role.

coords.description: A view of this kind has only the role values, so no coordinate comes from another role. A preset over this kind may take them from one of its own roles.
